description: Fourniture de matériel de plomberie et d’arrosage en 3 lots sur 4 ans - Lot 1 Céramique-Robinetterie-Vannes et robinets-Divers is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Brignoles. The contract consists of the purchase of plumbing and watering equipment for the city of Brignoles. This is a framework agreement for supplies with multi-awarded order forms, with no minimum amount and with a maximum amount, awarded for one year, renewable three times by express means for the same period. Coverage: Commune de Brignoles. The portal shows the English title as "Supply of plumbing and watering equipment in 3 lots over 4 years - Lot 1 Ceramic-Robinetterie-Vannes and faucets-Miscell" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Brignoles. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2024-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
